run_automix_main: run the automix script to create realistic mixes with stems from different songs aligned by BPM and pitch
build_track_from_catalog: build a new track by mixing stems from different songs with tempo and pitch alignment
analyse_track_bpm_pitch: analyse a track to extract BPM, beat onsets, and chroma distribution from the bass line
align_stems_beat_onsets: align the first beats of multiple audio stems using a gaussian grid matching approach
find_best_pitch_shift: find the optimal pitch shift in semitones between two chroma distributions by comparing rolled histograms
